help: Only the most battle hardened warriors filled with a lust for revenge will return as a Grave Knight.  This undead warrior may be sentient, but it has no understanding of a living world now alien to him.  It can only see its own bloodlust and thirst for vengeance. Only the most powerful Masterminds can control them.
power_short_helps: Auto Res Sleep, Fear, Disorient, Slow, Cold, Negative, Toxic, Psionic
